title: Coordinate the existing VS Code Claude session by peer name and shared reply
content: Verified 2026-10-24 under owner's explicit request to coordinate Claude, Grok and Kimi3. `claude agents --json --cwd E:\UzmiGames\UzPainter` finds active session UUID/name. A transient public CLI helper with `claude -p --model haiku --tools ListAgents,SendMessage --allowedTools ListAgents,SendMessage --permission-mode dontAsk --no-session-persistence --verbose --output-format stream-json` discovers peers and sends to NAME uzpainter-66; raw session UUID was not routable. Parse actual tool_result success/msg_id, not just model prose. The helper exits normally, so instruct the ongoing VS Code session to acknowledge/report in existing tmp/claude-supervision-reply.json; Codex updates tmp/claude-supervision.json. No private IPC, session fork/resume, trust modification or permission bypass. Keep disjoint ownership; one native build, no source edits during it; no new worktrees/temp directories per owner override. 9router config already exists in .env (NINEROUTER_BASE_URL/API_KEY); read key in memory without logging. Requested IDs kimi/kimi-k3 and xai/grok-4.5 returned kimi-k3/grok-4.5. Initial nonstream calls returned503; bounded streaming calls completed. Set UTF-8 stdout or ensure_ascii=True before printing model text, and enforce a total deadline so heartbeat traffic cannot hold a socket indefinitely. Send own source/docs/synthetic tests only, not private Painter captures. Validate model proposals against local code: Kimi invented filenames and mistook absent dossier content for absent project evidence. Source/effect work commits7604e4e1/0589eaa2/a9ed5ac0, Codex validator694f988a, ACK fields and message IDs in shared channel establish actual collaboration. Root remains active even though relay helper names are transient.
